The '''Advanced alacrity implant''' fine-tuned the user's [[nervous system]], allowing for vastly improved reaction times and coordination over unmodified individuals. However, the success of this costly implant prompted some at rival [[Bavakar Medical Research Labs]] to call for its banning. It is unknown as to whether a ban had been passed on this device.

==Behind the scenes==
The advanced alacrity implant made its first appearance in [[BioWare]]'s [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. In the game, its only appearance was as a purchasable item in the inventory of Suvam Tan on his space station above the planet Yavin. It only appears in his inventory after the player character finds the last [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Map]].
It was a level-three implant in the game and gave the user a very large bonus to his or her dexterity attribute.<ref name="kotor" />
